WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    oi.freight_value,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp
  FROM orders.order_items oi
  JOIN orders.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN orders.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ'
    AND oi.freight_value IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-08-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01')
      OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-08-01')
    )
),
periods AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-08-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01' THEN 'window'
      ELSE 'baseline'
    END AS period,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month_start,
    freight_value
  FROM filtered
),
window_agg AS (
  SELECT AVG(freight_value) AS value, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM periods WHERE period = 'window'
),
baseline_agg AS (
  SELECT AVG(freight_value) AS baseline, COUNT(*) AS n_baseline
  FROM periods WHERE period = 'baseline'
),
baseline_monthly AS (
  SELECT AVG(freight_value) AS month_avg
  FROM periods
  WHERE period = 'baseline'
  GROUP BY month_start
),
spread_calc AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 2 THEN STDDEV(month_avg) ELSE NULL END AS spread
  FROM baseline_monthly
)
SELECT
  ROUND(wa.value, 4) AS value,
  ROUND(ba.baseline, 4) AS baseline,
  ROUND(sc.spread, 4) AS spread,
  wa.n,
  ba.n_baseline
FROM window_agg wa, baseline_agg ba, spread_calc sc;
